definitions.prediction: Score-weighted mean of the top-5 re-ranked candidates within 100 m of the top one
definitions.failure_type: no_coverage: no reference within 100 m; success: top-1 within 100 m; ranking: covered and within top 50; retrieval: covered, not in top 50
definitions.majority_location: Fixed city-centre coordinate MAJORITY_BASELINE_LATLNG (mean of the most populated 1 km cell of the original gallery); independent of the evaluated gallery
definitions.random_reference: Exact expectation of predicting a uniformly random reference
definitions.reranking_ceiling: Share with a reference within 100 m in the top 50; geometric verification cannot recover matches beyond the same scene

target.criterion: >= 40% within 500 m AND system 95% CI does not overlap and lies above the majority-location baseline CI

random_reference.note: Exact expectation over all references; count is fractional

robustness.note: Diagnostics only; the development set itself is not reweighted or filtered

flags: spatial_clustering: 34/66 photos within 1000 m of one point

rerank.selection_rule: max dev top-1-region within 100 m, then within 500 m, then smaller w (fixed before tuning)
rerank.threshold_rule: smallest threshold with confident subset >= 80% within 500 m on dev
rerank.tuned_on: 66 dev photos only; test set untouched
